title: TikTok Shop Fee Calculator: Estimate Fees, Net Payout, and Profit
summary: Estimate TikTok Shop fees and net payout by region. See how discounts, COGS, shipping, and affiliate commission affect per-unit profit and margin.
body_markdown:
## Frequently Asked Questions


### What is the transaction fee on TikTok Shop?


The exact name, rate, and calculation base depend on your market, product category, and account, so confirm the current figures in TikTok Shop Seller Center before pricing.


### Is selling on TikTok Shop worth it after fees?


Selling on TikTok Shop can be profitable when your per-unit math shows positive margin after platform deductions and business costs. Start with the order amount subject to the referral fee, subtract COGS, outbound shipping, affiliate commission, ad spend, and expected returns, then compare estimated net payout against estimated profit before setting prices.


### How does a tiktok shop fee calculator work?


A tiktok shop fee calculator applies your shop's referral rate to the specified calculation base, then subtracts the costs you enter, such as COGS, shipping, affiliate commission, ad spend, and return-related costs. Treat the output as an estimate and verify each deduction against a real Seller Center payout statement before updating prices.


### How much do TikTok ads cost per 1,000 views?


For fee calculator purposes, what matters is your allocated ad spend per order, which you should enter as a per-unit cost so platform fees and advertising expenses stay distinct.


### How much should I charge for a TikTok post as an affiliate?


Creator rates for a TikTok post depend on audience size, engagement, and deliverables, so most agreements are negotiated individually. On TikTok Shop, creators typically earn an affiliate commission set as a percentage of the order or a per-order amount agreed with the seller, which sellers should budget into their per-unit profit estimates.


### Is payment processing included in TikTok Shop fees?


Payment processing may or may not be a separate charge depending on your market and account fee schedule. Do not add a generic payment-processing percentage on top of an existing referral or transaction charge, because double-counting can overstate your costs. Confirm fee labels and bases in Seller Center first.


### How do seller discounts affect the TikTok Shop referral fee base?


A seller-funded discount reduces what the customer pays, but whether the referral fee is calculated before or after the discount depends on TikTok's stated rules for that promotion and market. Check the documented calculation base in Seller Center and record platform-funded offers separately from discounts your shop pays to measure a promotion's true impact on margin.


### How do I confirm my actual TikTok Shop fee rates?


Open the current fee information in TikTok Shop Seller Center for your market, confirm your product category, fee name, rate, and calculation base, then review a completed order's payout details for the actual deductions. Update your estimates whenever TikTok changes a rate or your product classification changes.
